lines.text: Handler. Welcome to the Common. Mind the table. It used to be a Habitat wall.
A Dominion permit is drilling for Thoughtstone in the Red Reaches. The vibration is shaking the Ochre Span — a Spanwright crossing older than anyone's records.
Bridges are not monuments. They are promises. Someone is breaking this one.
Dexter Mane's name is on the permit. His decisions branch like lightning. I want to see where this one lands.
Survey the Reaches, understand what's there, and keep the Span standing. The Gate is yours when you're ready.

choice.text: We go now. Open the Gate.

lines.text: A rope. A boulder. Something big that drills. And one blank spot I can't read at all. Fun!
Mara marks the Gate as cleared for descent.
